### Approach
The approach to solve this problem involves using a hash map (dictionary in Python) to keep track of the numbers we have seen so far as we iterate through the list. For each number, we calculate its complement (target minus the current number). If this complement is found in the hash map, we have found our pair, and we return the indices.         num_to_index[num] = index

